## Problem

Suppliers and policyholders are experiencing delayed payments and delayed status updates. The delays trace to slow webhook retries and approval processes, which disrupt real-time claim processing and create financial friction for downstream partners.

## Who is affected

- Orrinbury Fleet Insurance reports delays with webhook retries on its supplier payments module, affecting how it processes claims and updates policyholders in real time [i:23d386fc82d6c342].
- Callowfield Auto Assurance reports that payments are being held up and that suppliers are starting to ask questions [i:2c5599e0c4552f3a].
- Holloway Reach Underwriting describes the impact as more than inconvenient, saying it is holding up payments and supplier invoices too [i:45301fb117b39eed].

## Evidence

- 3 accounts have raised this issue across 3 mentions, spanning 2 routes: sales with 2 mentions and support with 1 mention [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- The 3 accounts represent £1690000.0 in total ARR: Orrinbury Fleet Insurance at £120000.0, Callowfield Auto Assurance at £1250000.0, and Holloway Reach Underwriting at £320000.0 [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- The sales route surfaced the webhook retry delay at Orrinbury Fleet Insurance on 2026-10-22 [i:23d386fc82d6c342] and the payment and supplier invoice hold-up at Holloway Reach Underwriting on 2026-10-17 [i:45301fb117b39eed].
- The support route surfaced the payment hold-up and supplier questions at Callowfield Auto Assurance on 2026-10-28 [i:2c5599e0c4552f3a].
- No insight in this set points the other way; each of the 3 cited insights describes delay or hold-up rather than resolution.

## Why now

- The issue is live across both routes, with 2 sales mentions and 1 support mention recorded between 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-28 [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- There are 0 renewals in the next 90 days as of 2026-11-03, so the nearest renewal dates are 2027-02-16 for Orrinbury Fleet Insurance, 2027-03-31 for Callowfield Auto Assurance, and 2027-08-22 for Holloway Reach Underwriting [i:23d386fc82d6c342][i:2c5599e0c4552f3a][i:45301fb117b39eed].
- The largest exposure in the set is Callowfield Auto Assurance at £1250000.0 in ARR, where the support route has already recorded supplier questions about held-up payments [i:2c5599e0c4552f3a].

</previous_draft>
